hero.headline: Steward the Village
hero.intro: The Village Steward Space is for those coordinating and executing for the success of the whole Village. Join circles, take on roles, and help shape our regenerative community through sociocratic governance.

steps.heading: Your Journey to Co-Creation
steps.intro: Each step deepens your connection with the community and helps you find where your gifts fit.

items.title: Attend Community Call
items.description: Learn about the basics and ask any immediate questions about {village}.

items.title: Participate in Events
items.description: Join potlucks, events, workshops, and parties on our land to experience the community.

items.title: Village Weaving Immersion (Optional)
items.description: Optional: spend immersive time in the village learning how it operates, observing circles in action, and discovering where your gifts are most needed. A beautiful step, but not required.
items.bullet1: Optional, join if it calls you

items.title: Community Training
items.description: Either complete our training in NVC (Nonviolent Communication), authentic relating, and other community practices, or demonstrate you already know and live these essential practices.
items.bullet1: Do the training, or show you already live it

items.title: Join the {village} Family
items.description: Contemplate and sign our {commitment}, formally becoming a member of the community.

items.title: Participate in a Circle
items.description: Join one of our sociocratic circles to contribute to community decision-making.
items.bullet1: Choose a circle aligned with your gifts

items.title: Explore Quests
items.description: Take on quests to contribute meaningfully to the village, or propose your own quest if you don't see your gift. A great way to demonstrate your commitment.

items.title: Co-Creator Right of Passage
items.description: Complete the right of passage with a vote from the Co-Creators circle to become a full member.

items.title: Explore & Apply for Roles
items.description: Find a role that aligns with your gifts and apply for the upcoming season.

ladder.heading: The Path of Growth
ladder.intro: Each new season requires successful role proposals to continue. As you grow, so does your voice and responsibility.

items.requirement: Apply and be approved for a seasonal role
After multiple seasons in a role

items.benefits: Highest voice, wisdom keeper, strategic guidance

arc.heading: Long-Term Growth
arc.intro: Your role deepens with each season.

items.description: Mentor to newer stewards and circle facilitators
Village wisdom keeper and strategic guide

seasons.heading: Seasonal Festivals
seasons.body: Every 3 months, the community votes on what kind of season comes next. Seasons aren't on a fixed cycle, they're chosen based on what {village} needs. Spring for new builds, Summer for events and energy, Fall for harvest and reflection, Winter for systems design and planning. Each seasonal transition is marked by a festival.

rights.heading: Your Rights and Responsibilities
rights.body: As a Village Steward, you hold real ownership of this place, and real responsibility for it. Read the full covenant between co-owners.

nextStep.heading: Your Next Step
nextStep.body: Tell us where you're coming from and what calls you here. We'll reach out with the right invitation.
nextStep.giftsLabel: What gifts do you bring? (skills, time, passion)
nextStep.giftsHint: e.g. regenerative farming, facilitation, web development...
nextStep.questionHint: Share what resonated, what you're looking for, or any questions on your heart...
nextStep.thanksBody: We've received your message and will be in touch soon with your next invitation into the village.
nextStep.footnote: Or join our next community call to learn more first.
